sloka: अब्रवीच्च परिष्वज्य सौमित्रिं राघवस्तदा ।दिष्ट्या त्वां वीर पश्यामि मरणात् पुनरागतम् ।। ६.१०२.३९ ।।
transliteration: abravīcca pariṣvajya saumitriṁ rāghavastadā ।diṣṭyā tvāṁ vīra paśyāmi maraṇāt punarāgatam ।। 6.102.39 ।।

translations.english: It is a difficult task even for Suras. Seeing Hanuman doing it all the Vanara leaders were amazed.
